Lead source: inbound trial signup (self-serve). Product: lightweight in-app meeting summarization SDK + agent for SDR coaching. Signed up 2026-03-01, used free credits to prototype. Key stakeholders: CTO (Ravi Singh), Head of Product (Marissa Cole), Legal (procurement review).

PII / retention concerns (main friction):
- They record customer calls that contain names, emails, payments mentions. Legal: "cannot hold raw transcripts >30 days"; wants redaction + configurable retention policies per workspace.
- Ask: token retention vs. message retention; need confirmation that embeddings/LM outputs are not stored by default (or can be disabled).
- Request for audit log visibility + exportable retention proofs for compliance.

Technical / product notes:
- Primary workload: streaming call-to-summary (near-realtime) + generating coaching highlights post-call (batch).
- Latency target: <500ms per streaming chunk for live summaries; end-to-end meeting summary available within 30s of call end.
- Throughput: currently 50-150 concurrent users, avg 300 API requests/minute during peak. Expect 2x growth in 6 months.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; wants defaults that minimize token cost (batching + prefix caching). Concerned about per-token surprise charges.
- Model preference: open models OK; prefer small-gen for summaries but need fallback to higher-quality model for coaching insights. Ask about model variants + automated fallback.

Security asks raised on calls: SSO/SAML for admin console, audit logs retention, KMS for customer-managed keys (nice to have), SOC2 attestation required for procurement. Currently only public-cloud deployment acceptable (no on-prem in roadmap).

Sales notes / quotes: "If we can't guarantee retention controls and a clear default 'no retention' hosted mode, legal won't sign." — Marissa (Head of Product).
